## Description

Learn continuous portfolio controls using actor-critic methods; TD3 adds safeguards to reduce value overestimation.

## Where it may fit

Controlled research environments with continuous allocation actions.

## Vehicles

Research equity, ETF, futures and crypto portfolios.

## Required data

OHLCV/features, position state, action bounds, reward, costs, market constraints and training seeds.

## Caveats

Off-policy RL is sensitive to hyperparameters and reward design; test many seeds and stress scenarios.
